title: feat(plugin-list): cap a page list block's rows and badge each tab with its list's count
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbEGgVmKgUnvqr54xB8Qupu1)_

Fixes #26613

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:页面里半宽及以上区域的列表块(`list-view`)不再画整张对象列表,而是只画前 N 行(块的 `dataSource.limit`,没写就是 5)、视图前四列的精简表格,没有工具栏、`#` 列和分页,末尾一个「查看全部 N 条 →」链接到对象列表(块绑定的视图)。`page:tabs` 里装列表块的页签,标签上显示各自列表的记录数。
- **为什么改**:HotCRM 销售首页的三个页签把整张对象列表(21 行、`#` 列、所有列、横向滚动条)塞在 KPI 下面;页面块应是摘要,完整列表走链接。
- **风险与回滚**:中低。无新元数据键(`dataSource.limit` 早已可写且已被块读取);窄区域的紧凑列表、对象列表页、没有页面包裹的块都不变。新增的发布面:i18n 键 `list.viewAllCount`(十个语言包)、`@object-ui/components` 导出 `usePageTabCountReporter`、`ListView` 两个宿主 prop。装列表块的页签改为预挂载(隐藏),所以首屏会为每个列表页签各发一次 `$top=5` 查询。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`(`cappedWindow` / `cappedPosture` / `settledTotal`);`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`(页签计数通道与 `forceMount`);`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.cappedPageBlock-26613.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.cappedPageBlock-26613.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-list-count-26613.test.tsx`,预期 10 个用例全绿;或打开 HotCRM 的 Sales Home,三个页签各显示计数,每个页签最多 5 行并以「查看全部 N 条 →」结尾。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A `list-view` block in a page region half the page or wider (the page renderer's measured `'full'` posture, objectui#12703) now takes a **capped posture** instead of drawing the whole object list:

- **Rows.** At most the block's `dataSource.limit`, and 5 (`CAPPED_LIST_DEFAULT_LIMIT`) when it states none. `limit` was already authorable on every page element's data binding (`ElementDataSourceSchema.limit`) and already read by this block, which lands it on `pagination.pageSize` (`LIST_VIEW_DATA_SOURCE`), so **no key is added**. The cap is the query's own window: `ListView` sizes `$top` from it, so a capped block never fetches the rest.
- **Columns.** The view's first four visible columns (`CAPPED_LIST_MAX_COLUMNS`) in a table fixed to the block's width; the rest are dropped, not scrolled. A view with no declared columns draws the object's `highlightFields` led by its name field (the grid's own first default rule, through the same `leadWithNameField`), else each record's display name.
- **No object-list chrome.** No toolbar, view tabs, `#` row-number column, pager or record-count bar. Each row opens its record; the first cell is a button so a keyboard reaches it.
- **The link.** 「View all N →」 (`list.viewAllCount`, new in all ten packs) to the object list on the block's bound view, the destination the compact list's "View all" already uses (`listHref` / `openList`, unchanged).

**Tabbed list blocks.** `page:tabs` opens a count channel to each panel (`usePageTabCountReporter`, exported from `@object-ui/components`). The `list-view` block reports the total its own query answered (`ListView`'s new `onTotalChange` host prop), and the tab's badge shows the sum, added to the `record:related_list` counts the strip already derives. A tab holding a `list-view` and no authored `count` is mounted while inactive (Radix `forceMount`, hidden by `data-[state=inactive]:hidden`), so its badge exists before the tab is opened. A second, hand-built count query was not used: the badge reads the rows' own query, so the two cannot disagree.

Unchanged: a region narrower than half the page keeps the compact list; a list outside any page region (the object list page, a block with no page around it, an unknown width) keeps the full list; a tab with no list block, or with an authored `count`, still mounts on open only.

Query cost on a page whose `page:tabs` holds N list tabs: before, one list query on load (the active tab, `$top` 50, the spec's display default) and one more per tab the user opens; now N list queries on load, each `$top` 5 (or the block's `limit`), and none when a tab is opened later.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListViewBlock.cappedPageBlock-26613.test.tsx` (new, real page renderer, real `page:tabs`, real `list-view`, a data source that honours `$top`/`$skip` and answers `total`): (a) a full-width block over 21 records draws 5 rows, asks for `$top` 5, draws the first four of five view columns, no toolbar and no grid, and links "View all 21" to the bound view; (b) `dataSource.limit: 3` caps at 3; (c) a three-tab block (21 / 8 / 3 records) badges each tab `21` / `8` / `3`, runs each tab's query capped at 5, and each tab shows 5 / 5 / 3 rows with its own "View all N"; (d) controls: the aside block stays compact, an unknown width keeps the full list.
- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-tabs-list-count-26613.test.tsx` (new): reports summed per tab with the inactive tab mounted; an authored `count` wins and its tab is not pre-mounted; a tab with no list block is not pre-mounted; an unmounted block withdraws its count; no reporter outside a panel.
- `ListViewBlock.compactRegion-12703.test.tsx` and `ListViewBlock.compactViewAll-12703.test.tsx`: the "wide region keeps the full list" controls now assert the capped posture, the half this card changes.

## Acceptance notes

- The page designer does not list block properties from the schema: `BLOCK_CONFIG` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/block-config.ts`) is a hand-curated table with no `list-view` entry, so `limit` is not exposed there in this PR. The table already supports `at: 'dataSource'` fields (`element:repeater` has a `dataSource.limit` number box), so a `list-view` entry is a small follow-up.
- The acceptance screenshot of Sales Home at 1280 px is not attached: this container has no HotCRM deployment.
- The capped table reads a column entry's own `label` before the field's, as the grid header does; cell values go through the shared cell renderers (`getCellRenderer`), as the compact rows do.

## Verification

At `c558a2cb` (branch merged with `main`), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-list packages/i18n` plus the components page-tabs/posture tests, every test under `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/`, `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559`, and the console tests that name the list block or `page:tabs` (`public-block-binding-reach`, `registry-inputs-spec-parity`, `ga-honoured-inputs-author-reach`, `public-contract`, `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484`, `src/services/`): Test Files 351 passed (351), Tests 4111 passed, 13 skipped.
- Before the merge, the full plugin-list, components and i18n suites: 691 files passed; the one red (i18n `count-families-11445`: `list.viewAllCount` was a plain count key) is fixed in this branch by making it a count family in every pack.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-list --filter=@object-ui/components --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 51 tasks successful.
- Ablations, each restored to the HEAD blob afterwards: forcing `capped = false` in `ListViewBlock` turns the three capped tests red; dropping the `forceMount` spread in `containers.tsx` turns the tabbed-badge tests red in both new files.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 34 commands; each run with its exit code recorded, 34/34 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- ui gates outside the derivation: `check-i18n-call-site-keys`, `check-i18n-en-drift`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-fixed`: all exit 0.
- PR-body gates against this body: see the os-dev report on the issue.
